```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

"""
Scraper for GPU price information (gpu-price-schema-v1)
Author: Automatically repaired to restore expected output.
"""

import json
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup


def normalize_availability(text: str) -> str:
    """Map page text to the standardized availability codes."""
    text = text.lower()
    if "in stock" in text:
        return "in_stock"
    if "out of stock" in text:
        return "out_of_stock"
    # Default
    return "unknown"


def scrape_product(url: str) -> dict:
    """
    Extract product data from the given URL.

    Returns a plain Python dictionary that matches the
    gpu-price-schema-v1 schema.
    """
    resp = requests.get(url)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "html.parser")

    product = {}

    # Product ID
    product_id_tag = soup.select_one('meta[itemprop="productID"]')
    product["product_id"] = product_id_tag["content"] if product_id_tag else ""

    # Title
    title_tag = soup.select_one("h1.product-title")
    product["title"] = title_tag.get_text(strip=True) if title_tag else ""

    # Price – assume currency symbol may be present
    price_tag = soup.select_one("span.price")
    if price_tag:
        # Remove any non‑digit characters except the decimal point
        price_text = price_tag.get_text().replace("$", "")
        try:
            product["price"] = float(price_text.replace(",", ""))
        except ValueError:
            product["price"] = None
    else:
        product["price"] = None

    # Availability
    avail_tag = soup.select_one("div.availability")
    avail_text = avail_tag.get_text(separator=" ", strip=True) if avail_tag else ""
    product["availability"] = normalize_availability(avail_text)

    # Rating – read the data‑rating attribute
    rating_tag = soup.select_one("div.rating span.overall-rating")
    rating = rating_tag["data-rating"] if rating_tag and rating_tag.has_attr("data-rating") else None
    product["rating"] = float(rating) if rating else None

    # URL (original request URL)
    product["url"] = url

    return product


# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Demo / CLI entry point
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    target_url = "https://example.test/gpu-1"
    data = scrape_product(target_url)

    # Emit JSON in the expected schema
    print(json.dumps((data,), indent=4))
```
